items.title: Gingerbread Child with a Heart Balloon
items.alt: Small gingerbread child in mint overalls and a yellow hair bow holding a red heart-shaped balloon.
items.description: The floating pose lifts both cookie feet, with one arm spread and the other gripping the thin balloon string.

items.title: Gingerbread Pushing a Gift Wheelbarrow
items.alt: Gingerbread character in an orange cap and teal vest pushing a red wheelbarrow carrying two ribboned presents.
items.description: The forward-leaning figure grips both handles while the red wheel and metal support legs remain visible.

items.title: Gingerbread Puppy Cookie
items.alt: Dog-shaped gingerbread cookie with floppy ears, a raised paw, pink tongue and a green peppermint collar.
items.description: White piping outlines the ears, paws and curved tail around the smiling chocolate-eyed puppy face.

items.title: Sleeping Gingerbread Cat Cookie
items.alt: Curled cat-shaped gingerbread cookie with chocolate stripes, closed icing eyes and a small red bow.
items.description: The striped tail wraps around the tucked front paws, with pink icing filling the pointed ears.

items.title: Gingerbread Fox Cookie
items.alt: Seated fox-shaped gingerbread cookie with white icing cheeks, chest and tail tip, decorated with holly by one ear.
items.description: The broad upright tail balances the pointed ears and small dark chocolate nose above two rounded cookie paws.

items.title: Gingerbread Owl Cookie
items.alt: Round owl-shaped gingerbread cookie with pale green icing eye rings and white scalloped feather piping, perched on an iced branch.
items.description: Large chocolate eyes and an orange beak stand above two tiny orange feet gripping the branch.
